chooser.off.starting: Still starting. Its files can be read once it runs.
chooser.off.attention: Its state needs a look in Computers, so its files can't be read.

chooser.findTop: Open a folder first: the top of a computer can't be searched in one go.

chooser.preview.gone: This file isn't there any more.
